approach: Edit one value in athena.toml (1800 to 3000), append decision D124 to docs/decisions.md in the D123 format, and add an entry under [Unreleased] in CHANGELOG.md. No code changes. docs/system-facts.md has no producer-timeout fact, so it stays unchanged unless the producer finds one. Editing it would also risk the budget drift test.

decisions.choice: Number the entry D124, appended after D123 (last entry, ends at line 3083), using the Case/Decision/Alternatives/Tradeoff/Reversal cost/Provenance format.
decisions.reason: Matches the existing format, so the decision log stays uniform.

rejected.option: Edit an earlier entry such as D113, which mentions the 1800 s deadline
rejected.why: Entries are a historical record; a new entry that supersedes it is clearer.

decisions.choice: Record splitting jobs, a faster suite and keeping work on timeout as queued alternatives, not built here. Give reversal as steps (set the value back to 1800, run cargo test) plus a signal.
decisions.reason: The request puts them out of scope but asks that they be recorded. The reversal signal is a number I have not measured, so the entry will label it as a proposal.

rejected.why: Code change in crates/, explicitly out of scope.

decisions.reason: I found no producer deadline value in it, and a stray edit could trip the budget drift test. Other 1800 hits are in unrelated test fixtures and historical docs.

rejected.option: Add a deadline fact to system-facts.md
rejected.why: Not asked for. It would change the file's size and the planner and critic budget lines.

files.purpose: Append D124 with evidence, queued alternatives and reversal.
Add the entry under [Unreleased], in the existing ### Changed section.

steps: Append D124 to the end of docs/decisions.md. Include the Case (the five named jobs, the sixth unnamed; 1800 s deadline; 5 to 10 minute test builds, reported not measured), the Decision, the Alternatives (splitting jobs, a faster suite, keeping work on timeout, each queued), the Tradeoff, the Reversal cost (set 1800, run cargo test) and Provenance.
Add the CHANGELOG entry under [Unreleased]: producer deadline raised from 1800 to 3000 s because six producer runs hit the deadline and lost their work; see D124.
Run cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings and cargo test --locked.

risks.risk: Entry text includes banned words or email-like text and fails the boundary scan.
risks.mitigation: Use neutral wording and no addresses; run cargo test --locked, which includes xtask policy tests.

risks.risk: The CHANGELOG is large (143 KB) and a wrong insertion point places the entry in a released section.
risks.mitigation: Insert under the first heading after '## [Unreleased]' (### Changed at about line 239, or the existing Unreleased ### Added) and check that the lines above are still within Unreleased.

risks.risk: A longer deadline raises the cost and wait of runs that hang.
risks.mitigation: Record this as the tradeoff, and give a reversal signal in the entry.

demonstrations.observes: Exactly one changed line, producer_timeout_s = 1800 to 3000; reader, producer_usd, verifier_timeout_s = 2400 and check_timeout_s = 900 unchanged.

demonstrations.method: Read the new entry in the diff.
demonstrations.observes: A new D124 entry naming 1800 to 3000, the five job ids with the sixth marked unnamed, the 5 to 10 minute build claim labeled as reported, three alternatives each marked queued, and reversal steps and signal.
A new bullet under [Unreleased] saying the producer deadline rose from 1800 to 3000 s and why.

demonstrations.method: Run the suite; the config test parses athena.toml, and clippy runs with warnings denied.
demonstrations.observes: All tests pass, including the repository config parse test with producer_timeout_s = 3000. Also run cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings with no warnings.
demonstrations.fails_without: A malformed or mistyped producer_timeout_s (for example a quoted string) would make the config parse test fail.
